text:
[issue by cregooo]
So I'm using the Better mineshafts mod which obviously requires the Yungs Api mod to work, But when I would try to actually use the API mod it would cause my game to crash with the log saying "Process crashed with exit code 1" And I'm on forge 1.16.5

[comment by yungnickyoung (member)]
Can you provide the crashlog and latest.log?

@RealTenzFate Your crash is due to some problem regarding client-side sound code, which the API doesn't touch. Also, you're mixing mods for various Minecraft versions so.. that's bound to cause some problems.
